notes: Prism 2.6.3: labels like the note count no longer act like editable text — clicking one used to leave a text cursor in it. Your notes, transcripts and titles still select and copy exactly as before. Also in this update: calls that recorded but came back empty now write a real note, the meeting card shows up for the second of two back-to-back meetings, two calls in one calendar block no longer overwrite each other, notes you renamed keep their names, and the app no longer freezes when a call ends. Your audio is never stored. Free.
